300 — Storage, Troubleshooting & Support

Something’s not working, or you want to make sure it doesn’t break in the first place. This module covers the toolkit for both.

In this module

  1. 301 — Storage on ICE — how shared storage works, why it fills up, and a real example of what “critical” looks like
  2. 302 — Auditing Your Storage Usage — Justin Yiu’s storage audit tool, what it reports, and how to run it yourself
  3. 303 — Validating Your Job Before Submission — Zach Wallace’s validator, catches script mistakes before they cause a failed job
  4. 304 — Checking System Status — rule out PACE-side issues before debugging your own script
  5. 305 — Getting Help — who to contact, in order, and what to include so you get a fast answer
